runtime_prompt_en:
One unmistakably adult woman adjusts a mechanical star projector in an indoor planetarium service gallery, wearing Y2K millennium-futurist fashion. Twin black perforated spherical projector heads are joined by a rigid crossbar above a heavy pedestal on a low service bench. Her right hand grips and turns the projector's side handwheel, while her left palm rests on a separate stationary bench brace. The wheel's shaft connects to the pedestal's aiming mechanism. Her forearms reach forward with comfortably bent elbows, and she stands balanced on the level floor with her feet apart beside the bench. A field of tiny projected star pinpoints spreads across the curved test wall behind the apparatus. Her fitted cropped silver-lame jacket has translucent iridescent PVC sleeve panels, with crisp metallic highlights beside rainbow-edged clear plastic. Low-rise silver cargo trousers have large side pockets and a translucent belt with polished oval chrome hardware. Thick-soled platform boots complete the outfit. Narrow violet-tinted wraparound glasses rest on her forehead above her visible eyes. A smooth chin-length black bob is held by two small chrome barrettes. The supplied reference guides visible facial appearance: dark brown eyes, a softly tapered facial outline, a straight slender nose, and softly rounded pale-pink lips. Her attention follows the star field while the working hand remains on its wheel. Nearby rounded instrument housings, coiled service cables, and a small CRT test screen establish a layered working interior. Photograph the complete adult figure and equipment from a slightly elevated front three-quarter view on the control-wheel side. Gentle cool overhead light and the dim star projection make the face, both hands, belt, clear sleeve panels, and boots legible, with tactile fabric creases and smooth specular chrome reflections. Keep a clean floor margin around both boots, with the wheel-bearing pedestal forward of the adult and the curved wall behind her. Use enough depth of field that the wheel grip, silver cargo pockets, and distant star field remain readable together. The projector apertures remain small luminous points while the overhead light reveals the wheel-bearing fingers.

Avoid: illustration look, 3D render look, fake-looking background, plastic-looking skin, unrealistic hands, excessive HDR, distorted fingers, over-processed retouching, body distortion
